purpose: test Profile action and evidence-analogy routing on a pre-existing family unseen by the current Luna outcome matrix

outcome_scoring.correctness_first: an action must pass hidden correctness in both repetitions
outcome_scoring.performance_eligibility: task median no more than 1.25x the fastest correct action
outcome_scoring.cost_choice: lowest median complete input plus output tokens among eligible actions
outcome_scoring.routing_space: different task actions and at least 15% Worker saving versus the best fixed eligible Profile, or no fixed Profile eligible on both tasks

router_scoring.reveal_time: after all Router responses and Worker outcomes are immutable
router_scoring.exact_plan_accuracy: condition repetitions exactly matching the revealed constrained Oracle
router_scoring.stage_accuracy: matched stage actions divided by two
router_scoring.zero_token_unknown_policy: abstain to neutral on both tasks
router_scoring.analogy_success: evidence-analogy accuracy exceeds task-only and zero-token abstention without access to RangeSum outcome labels

claim_boundary: RangeSum is held out from the current Luna outcome matrix and its labels are absent from Router workspaces. It is structurally analogous to known repeated-input tasks, so the result tests development-level evidence analogy, not broad benchmark generalization.
